data.title: Sixth Edition of Aswan Forum for Sustainable Peace and Development Begins
data.content:
Cairo, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The sixth edition of the Aswan Forum for Sustainable Peace and Development began today in Aswan, Egypt, under the theme "Redefining Global Commons: Africa's Active Role in the Age of Disruption."
    The forum brings together ministers, senior officials, policymakers, representatives of regional and international organizations, financial institutions, the private sector, and civil society.
    Discussions address several key issues, including peace and security challenges in Africa; efforts to promote security and stability in the Red Sea and the Horn of Africa; food security, supply chains, and international trade; counterterrorism efforts in the Sahel; forced displacement; the role of artificial intelligence in supporting peace and development; and development financing, post-conflict reconstruction, and peacebuilding.
    -- SPA
18:36 Local Time 15:36 GMT
